title: 收到医疗账单有疑问，怎么问？
summary: 收到看不懂的医疗账单：打电话问明细、确认保险报了没、申请分期付款。

featuredPhrase.en: I have a question about my bill.

phrases.en: I have a question about my bill.

phrases.zh: 能解释一下这些收费吗？

phrases.en: Can I set up a payment plan?
Can you send me an itemized bill?
phrases.zh: 能给我一份明细账单吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, I have a question about my bill. It's much higher than I expected.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我对账单有疑问，比我预期的高太多了。

dialogue.speaker: Billing
dialogue.en: It looks like the claim was denied. You may need to meet your deductible first.
dialogue.zh: 看起来保险拒赔了，你可能要先花够免赔额。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: I see. Can I set up a payment plan?

dialogue.speaker: Billing
dialogue.en: Of course. We can split it into 6 monthly payments.
dialogue.zh: 当然，可以分成 6 个月付。

seoTitle: 美国医疗账单看不懂怎么办？问账单的英语
seoDescription: 收到天价医疗账单别慌。本文教你打电话问明细、确认保险、分期付款的英语说法，附真实对话。
